newsitem.title: CHINA: China's imports of crude oil soar 32 pct for 1996.
newsitem.headline: China's imports of crude oil soar 32 pct for 1996.

text.p: China's imports of crude oil soared by 32 percent in 1996 to 22.62 million tonnes, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday quoting customs figures.
It gave no figures for exports for the year.
China imported 20.53 million tonnes of crude oil in the first 11 months, up 41.6 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed.
China's crude oil exports in the first 11 months reached 17.96 million tonnes, up 8.1 percent compared with the same year-ago period, the figures showed.
China imported 17.09 million tonnes of crude in 1995, up by 38.4 percent from 1994. Exports in 1995 were 18.85 million tonnes, up by 1.5 percent year-on-year.
